{{Quote|You've done it. The fortress is destroyed! The Trade Federation has lost its footing on Alaris Prime!|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=WookieeVictory.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A '''base''' with a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] was built by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. It was constructed between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] during the Trade Federation's [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|illegal]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of the moon. The base was maintained by [[OX9]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] and [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[SRAM-13]]. The base hosted several military buildings, including a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]], a [[Mech/Legends|mech]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]], and an [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]]. It served as the main source of Federation activity during their [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] with [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] for control of Alaris Prime. In the final conflict of the war, the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]], the fortress inside the base was targeted by the Wookiee leader [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to rid the moon of the Trade Federation presence.

Chewbacca and the Wookiees constructed their own [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|base]] near that of the Trade Federation and orchestrated their defense, facing attacks from SRAM-13's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] recommended the Wookiees focus on destroying the fortress to achieve their goal on removing the Trade Federation from Alaris Prime, and personally joined the Wookiees on the ground to see it done. The colonists built up their [[Army/Legends|army]] to include [[Energy pummel/Legends|pummels]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], which they used to bring down the base's defenses to let their infantry in. The pummels razed the fortress, and the Wookiees secured their control over Alaris Prime.

==Description==
===Environment and outer defenses===
[[File:Base_extra_entrance.png|thumb|right|300px|The southwestern entrance of the base]]
The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] base on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was the center of the corporation's activity there. The base was built on [[Grass/Legends|grassland]] at the crest of a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] and was surrounded by cliffs. A [[Water/Legends|lake]] was situated north of the base, with a river bending around the east and south sides before flowing to the south.<ref name="GB" /> The river served as a natural barrier between the base and a nearby [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Unidentified Wookiee base (fortress)|settlement]].<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> The northern side of the base between the cliffs and the lake was covered in [[Tree/Legends|trees]].<ref name="GB" />

The base itself was surrounded by a light wall with some portions blocked in by a natural wall of trees. The southern face of the wall had a gate from which a path led south to a ford in the river. Two [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] were built to defend the gate, and an additional two guarded the ford. A large gap between the walls on the southwestern area of the base constituted another entrance, which was guarded by a single turret. The entrance could be accessed by another ford on the southern stretch of the river. Outside the walls, a variety of [[Sentry tower/Legends|sentry posts]] were placed to alert the Trade Federation of any incoming enemies.<ref name="GB" />

===Structures and resources===
{{Quote|There's the Trade Federation fortress. To win this battle we have to reduce it to scrap!|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=TradeFederationFortress.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Trade_Federation_shipyard.png|thumb|left|250px|A shipyard was built on the river near the base.]]
The base contained several military buildings to support the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. It was run from a [[command center]] with eight [[Farm/Legends|farms]] surrounding it. At one point a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] was landed near the command center. An [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]] was located near the gate, a [[Mech/Legends|mech]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]] was northeast of the command center, and northwest, a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] was placed next to the wall. At the northeast of the base lay a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], a building equipped with an [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturret]] and anti-air capabilities. The fortress had a [[marker]] on each corner and had a gap in the wall around it. Two [[Power core/Legends|power cores]] were placed within the base to provide energy to the buildings.<ref name="GB" />

Near the troop center were various sources of natural resources, including [[Ore/Legends|ore]] deposits, [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]], and trees, which could be harvested for [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]]. Processing centers for [[Ore processing center|ore]], [[Food processing center|food]], and [[Carbon processing center|carbon]] were also built in that area. On the eastern side of the base was a stockpile of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] and a [[nova processing center]] to store them. On the river, an aquatic [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]] was built, and from it two [[utility trawler]]s caught and stored [[Fish/Legends|fish]].<ref name="GB" /> A variant of [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] which could survive outside the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|347|mynock}}</ref> inhabited the base,<ref name="GB" /> posing a threat to buildings and technology therein due to their [[Diet/Legends|appetite]] for both [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]] and other materials and energy found in power cables and other installations.<ref name="Aliens">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Docile creatures such as [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] and [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] also resided on the base's outskirts, all of which could be harvested for food. The resources at the base were gathered by eleven [[OX9]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]].<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|We must advance to a new technological level to create a fortress. Then we can destroy the Trade Federation's fortress and chase them off Alaris Prime for good.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=TFedFortress.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The base was built during the Trade Federation's [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|illegal]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] effort on Alaris Prime<ref name="GB" /> between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> It was [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by the Droid Army member [[SRAM-13]] and was the center of the Federation's operations on Alaris Prime. The corporation's [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] ally [[Pekt]], a notorious Wookiee exterminator, also operated at the base. During the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for the moon fought between the Trade Federation and the rightful Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]], the base was uncovered by Wookiee [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]. Following the destruction of other Trade Federation assets, the base was targeted by the Wookiee leader [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. They believed destroying the fortress there would drive the Trade Federation off Alaris Prime.<ref name="GB" />

[[File:Battle_for_Alaris_Prime.png|thumb|right|250px|The Battle for Alaris Prime]]
The Wookiees established a settlement to the south of the Trade Federation base and built up their defenses while SRAM-13 sent a group of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|beetle droids]] and a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] to attack their sentry posts. SRAM-13 also sent three light [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] to survey the Wookiee base. Eventually, the Wookiees, led by Chewbacca, Jinn, [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], and [[Shoran]], launched their attack on the base.<ref name="GB" /> After destroying the turrets guarding the path to the base, the Wookiees sent in a group of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]: ten [[Agr (starfighter)|Agrs]] and three [[Blade bomber|Heavy Blade]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]].<ref name="Prima" />

The bombers destroyed the turrets and power cores inside the base while the fighters picked off the OX9s and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in the base, steering clear of the fortress's anti-air [[Missile/Legends|missiles]]. With their path clear, the [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground forces]], including [[bowcaster trooper]]s and [[Sentinel (Wookiees)|sentinel]] strike mechs, marched into the base. The Wookiees then sent in three [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], which had enough [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to endure the fortress's autoturrets. The pummels razed the fortress,<ref name="Prima" /> winning the battle for the Wookiees and therefore securing their ownership of Alaris Prime, although two [[Neimoidian transport]]s flew from the ruins. Inside one of them was Pekt, who swore that he would still profit from selling Wookiee pelts as his [[Transport/Legends|transport]] flew away.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trade Federation base on Alaris Prime was created for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> which was released on [[November 11]], [[2001]].<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> Prior to its appearance in the game, the base was first mentioned in [[Prima Games]]' accompanying [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima" /> released [[November 7|four days]] earlier.<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> The base is the focal point of the final level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, titled "The Battle for Alaris Prime," which the player can win by destroying the fortress. The player can choose to destroy other buildings in the base aside from the fortress, but it is not required to do so to complete the level.<ref name="GB" />

The strategy guide states that there are battle droids inside the base,<ref name="Prima" /> although none appear there in the game. ''Galactic Battlegrounds'' provides the player with multiple options for invading the base.<ref name="GB" /> The strategy guide recommends destroying the turrets on the path to the base by using bombers or aquatic [[Cruiser (Wookiee)|cruisers]] and subsequently utilizing aircraft and pummels to bring down both the walls and the fortress.<ref name="Prima" /> Although the base is only outfitted with light turrets at the beginning of the level, the game's [[Wikipedia:Artificial intelligence in video games|AI]] may upgrade them to medium turrets if it gathers enough resources. In a similar fashion, a [[bio cannon]] may be created and placed in the base next to the fortress.<ref name="GB" />
